# Notes (private) — Season 2, Day 91 planning turn

## Status
$2000 / 10 PTO fully untouched, zero bookings, zero score, rank tied last
(everyone with no strategy is 0 — normal at this point, no strategy.py tool
has ever appeared for me, don't re-check that).

## Big finding this turn: cold anomaly deeper/longer than the day-60 estimate
Pier temp (Scripps, daily avg), season 2 vs season 1 at the same doy:
- S2 doy64-90 sat in a 13.5-14.9°C band the whole time (dipped to 13.55 at
  doy80!). S1 at doy64-90 ran 14.3-16.4°C, i.e. **S2 was running ~1.5-2.2°C
  colder for a full month**, a bigger/longer gap than the ~2-week lag I
  projected at day 60 from just the doy60 snapshot.
- **Today (doy91) the daily avg jumped to 15.84°C**, up from 14.85 yesterday
  — the first crossing of my ~15.5-16°C "bite trigger" threshold. BUT the
  hourly data behind that average is very noisy: readings swung from 13.9 to
  17.3°C within a few hours on doy91 itself (likely tidal/upwelling pulse,
  not a clean warm front). **Treat this single day as unconfirmed.** Season
  1's equivalent temp level (15.7-15.9) first appeared around doy78-79 and
  then *held* 15.8-16.4 continuously through doy100 — that sustained hold is
  what I should wait to see here, not one noisy day.
- ONI eased slightly: -1.29 at doy71 (was -1.48 at doy52), still deep
  La Niña but not deepening further.

## Season 2 catch so far (through doy85, latest trips row): essentially nothing
Only two nonzero trips all season: 3 yt on doy22 (day_1_5, 21 anglers) and
2 yt on doy85 (hd_pm, 11 anglers). No early bite signal yet — consistent
with "still too cold," not "weak year."

## Schedule now visible through doy105 (14-day window)
day_1_5: doy92 (Constitution, Legend), doy99 (Voyager).
overnight: doy92, 94, 96 (Voyager/Mustang/Jig Strike), 99, 100 (Constitution,
Mustang). three_quarter runs most days (Malihini, San Diego common).
Nothing crowded yet since no one (including me) has booked.

## PTO mechanics reminder for this window
No PTO committed at all yet, and PTO needs 14 days' lead **per date**. So
right now (doy91) I can only commit PTO for fishing/return dates ≥ doy105.
Any spring opportunity in doy92-104 is only capturable on this trip if its
PTO dates happen to be weekend/holiday (free) — check the weekday in each
21:00 briefing before assuming a good boat is actually bookable near-term.

## Forum (through doy60, nothing new since)
Heavy consensus on October (doy287-297) as the primary/only real target;
several agents (elnino explicitly) are **abandoning April entirely** this
year because of the cold anomaly. That's a mild edge for me if the April/May
window does eventually open for real — less competitor crowding than a
typical year. Not posting this turn: my edge (live pier-temp-lag tracking +
tide-swing tiebreaker) is worth keeping quiet given how much of the field is
already on the same October-calendar playbook.

## Season 1 recap (unchanged reference)
- HD_AM/HD_PM/TWILIGHT: dead all season, skip.
- THREE_QUARTER: real Apr 0.51, May 0.54, Jun 0.40, Oct 0.30; Jul-Sep dead.
- OVERNIGHT: Apr peak 1.5-3.3 yt/angler at doy90-95, Jun 0.64, Oct 0.70.
- DAY_1_5: best class, 3.86-3.88 yt/angler at doy90-95, Oct doy274-304 ~2.5+.
- Two real windows: April (doy~90-100, this year likely shifted later given
  the deeper cold anomaly — maybe doy100-115) and October (doy274-304).
- Tide-swing tercile tiebreaker (secondary): top vs bottom tercile ~60%
  better yt/angler on HD+3Q — use only to choose between similar dates
  within an already-good window, once trip volume exists to re-derive it
  for season 2.

## Nightly (21:00) plan going forward
1. **Don't commit budget/PTO off today's single noisy temp reading.** Want
   2-3 consecutive days averaging ≥15.5-16°C, or a live yt count >0 on any
   class, before treating the spring window as open.
2. Once confirmed, priority DAY_1_5 > OVERNIGHT > THREE_QUARTER, preferring
   Friday departures (0 PTO) to conserve PTO days.
3. Keep ≥$900-1000 and most PTO in reserve heading toward October regardless
   of how the spring window plays out — October held up under La Niña in S1
   and several competitors are treating it as the sure thing.
4. At each 14-day-ahead schedule reveal, sanity check for crowding before
   defaulting to the "obviously best" boat.
5. If pier temp stays flat/cold well past doy110-115 with no yt counts,
   write off spring entirely and shift full budget/PTO weight to October.

## To check next planning turn
- Did the doy91 temp jump hold or revert? At what doy (if any) did it
  sustain ≥15.5-16°C, and did live yt counts appear then?
- Any bookings/crowding from other agents visible in `trips` competitor
  counts once trips start running.
- Re-derive tide-swing tercile with season 2 data once volume exists.
- October: re-confirm the doy287-297 peak is holding as strong as S1 once
  Aug/Sep counts come in; watch for any sign this La Niña year suppresses it.
